sections.section_title: A single XSPI drives two external memories
sections.text_helper: Section 29.5.8 "A single XSPI drives two external memories" in chapter 29 (XSPI I/O manager (XSPIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1367.
sections.section_content:
This is a subset of direct mode and corresponds to semi-dynamic switching. There are two
target memories, but the arbiter is not used. The software must set the XSPI1 chip selector
(bit 24 of the XSPI_CR register) each time the target memory changes.
The baseline use case boots on flash (memory1) and then switches to SRAM (memory2) for
the rest of the application.

This use case shows a configuration using XSPI1 on Port 1. It is also valid if the instance is
XSPI2 instead of XSPI1, but with MODE = 1. The use case is also valid when Port 2 is used
instead of Port 1, by configuring MODE bit according to the instance (XSPI1 or XSPI2)
driving the two external memories.
